sections.title: From destination to placement
sections.content: *-ra/-re* is the sublative suffix — motion onto the top of a surface. You have already seen it inside *jobbra* and *balra*. It is what you need when you put an object somewhere: *tesz* ("to put, to place") plus *-ra/-re* says exactly where it lands.

items.english: I put the box onto the shelf.

items.spanish: Károly a táskát az asztalra teszi.
items.english: Károly puts the bag onto the table.

sections.content: Unlike *-on/-en/-ön*, *-ra/-re* only has two forms, not three — no rounded/unrounded split needed here, just back vs. front: *polcra*, but *székre*.
